We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (ID 149040) to the molecule from previous step. The previous input: make_5_lvl1-template_search-4 gave mapped_rxn and template_id 149040. The mapped_rxn is a reaction SMILES showing reactants and product. The product is the target molecule (the one we need to apply template to). The reactants are the precursors. The mapped_rxn: 'O=S(=O)(O[Si:11]([CH3:12])([CH3:13])[C:14]([CH3:15])([CH3:16])[CH3:17])C(F)(F)F.[CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([OH:10])[C@@H:18]([CH3:19])[C@@H:20](/[CH:21]=[C:22](/[CH3:23])[C:24](=[O:25])[O:26][CH3:27])[O:28]1>>[CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([O:10][Si:11]([CH3:12])([CH3:13])[C:14]([CH3:15])([CH3:16])[CH3:17])[C@@H:18]([CH3:19])[C@@H:20](/[CH:21]=[C:22](/[CH3:23])[C:24](=[O:25])[O:26][CH3:27])[O:28]1'

Thus the reactants are two molecules: 
1) O=S(=O)(O[Si:11]([CH3:12])([CH3:13])[C:14]([CH3:15])([CH3:16])[CH3:17])C(F)(F)F
2) [CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([OH:10])[C@@H:18]([CH3:19])[C@@H:20](/[CH:21]=[C:22](/[CH3:23])[C:24](=[O:25])[O:26][CH3:27])[O:28]1

These are the precursors. The task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl1-template_search-4 to the molecule below". The molecule below? Not given but presumably the product is the target. So we need to output list of lists of SMILES strings for each possible combination. Usually apply_template may give multiple combos if template can be applied in multiple ways. But we have the mapped reaction which gives one specific combination. So answer should be list containing one inner list with the two SMILES.

We need to ensure SMILES are canonical? Use as given. Might need to ensure no spaces. Provide as list of lists.

Thus answer: [['O=S(=O)(O[Si]([CH3])([CH3])[C]([CH3])([CH3])[CH3])C(F)(F)F', '[CH3][CH2][O][C](=O)[CH2][C@H]1[CH2][C@H]([OH])[C@@H]([CH3])[C@@H](/[CH]=[C](/[CH3])[C](=O)[O][CH3])[O]1']] but need to keep atom mapping numbers? Usually SMILES without mapping. The reactant SMILES include mapping numbers like [Si:11] etc. Should we strip mapping? The tool apply_template returns SMILES without mapping. But we can just use the reactant SMILES as given (including mapping). The required format likely expects plain SMILES without mapping. However the mapping numbers are part of SMARTS? They are atom map numbers, which are allowed in SMILES. Might be okay.

Better to provide the SMILES without mapping: remove :11 etc. Let's produce cleaned SMILES.

First reactant: O=S(=O)(O[Si]([CH3])([CH3])[C]([CH3])([CH3])[CH3])C(F)(F)F

Second reactant: CH3CH2O C(=O)CH2C@H1CH2C@H(OH)C@@H(CH3)C@@H(/CH=C(/CH3)C(=O)OCH3)O1? Need to convert. The given SMILES with mapping: [CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([OH:10])[C@@H:18]([CH3:19])[C@@H:20](/[CH:21]=[C:22](/[CH3:23])[C:24](=[O:25])[O:26][CH3:27])[O:28]1

Remove mapping numbers: CH3CH2O C(=O)CH2C@H1CH2C@H(OH)C@@H(CH3)C@@H(/CH=C(/CH3)C(=O)OCH3)O1

Write as: CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC[C@H](O)C@@H(C)C@@H(/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1? Need to ensure correct.

Simplify: [CH3][CH2][O][C](=[O])[CH2][C@H]1[CH2][C@H]([OH])[C@@H]([CH3])[C@@H](/[CH]=[C](/[CH3])[C](=[O])[O][CH3])O1

We can keep bracket notation.

Thus final answer list: [["O=S(=O)(O[Si]([CH3])([CH3])[C]([CH3])([CH3])[CH3])C(F)(F)F", "[CH3][CH2][O][C](=[O])[CH2][C@H]1[CH2][C@H]([OH])[C@@H]([CH3])[C@@H](/[CH]=[C](/[CH3])[C](=[O])[O][CH3])O1"]]
